metadata.description:
Reconstructed grids and animations supporting Dutkiewicz and Müller, Global carbonate compensation depth evolution over the last 170 million years and its drivers.

The archive holds compacted and decompacted pelagic carbonate sediment thickness grids and their deposition masks at 1 Myr from 170 Ma to the present, under minimum, central and maximum carbonate sedimentation-rate scenarios; the merged paleobathymetry grids that drive them; the reconstructed continental masks; the plate model the reconstructions run on; the observed present-day carbonate thickness grids used for validation; and the two supplementary animations. All grids are global NetCDF at 0.25 degrees, in reconstructed (paleo) coordinates.

README.md in the archive describes every file, the three scenarios and how to use the grids with the analysis code. MANIFEST.txt carries a SHA-256 checksum for every file.

The code that produces these grids, the derived CCD curves, the figures and the supplementary datasets are at https://github.com/EarthByte/CCD.
